resources.string: The first period must start between 00:00 and 23:59. This change was not applied.
Use 1–1439 periods that fit within the day. This change was not applied.
Period lengths must be positive and breaks cannot be negative. This change was not applied.
Periods and breaks must finish by 23:59 on the same day. This change was not applied; reduce the count, lengths, or breaks.
